product_overview: Weet Website Platform is a comprehensive web solution featuring a public-facing site with product listings, solutions, support resources, and company information, alongside a secure and robust admin panel for content management, product administration, customer insights, and inquiry handling. The platform employs modern web technologies to ensure high performance, responsiveness, and seamless user experience across all devices.
core_goals: Provide an engaging, informative public website showcasing products, solutions, and company information.
Enable efficient, secure content management through an admin panel with user authentication.
Support product lifecycle management including listing, addition, and editing of products.
Facilitate customer support and inquiry management with CRM capabilities integrated into admin dashboard.
Ensure high standards of visual quality, responsiveness, and error-free operation across all pages and devices.
key_features: Public Homepage with hero carousel, feature highlights, and partner showcases.
Company information page detailing corporate identity and team presentation.
Public product listings segmented into Bespoke and Modular categories with detailed product pages supporting lazy loading and smooth navigation.
Solutions page displaying detailed solution subpages with optimized images and minimal layout shift.
Support section featuring FAQ and customer help resources.
Secure admin dashboard including main page CMS, product management, solution and support CMS, customer insights, inquiry management, and settings.
Authentication system implemented with Supabase handling login, session management, and protected routes.
Responsive mobile and desktop navigation including hamburger menus and dropdowns.
Robust form validation and error handling for inquiry and support forms with success toasts.
Performance optimizations including image optimization, lazy loading, and minimal content layout shifts.
user_flow_summary: Visitors land on the homepage and navigate through featured products, solutions, company details, and support resources.
Users browse product listings by category and access detailed product information with navigation back to listings.
Admin users authenticate via login page; invalid credentials show errors, valid credentials redirect to dashboard.
Admins manage homepage content, products, solutions, support FAQs, and view customer insights through dedicated CMS interfaces.
Admins handle customer inquiries via dashboard with real-time updates.
Session handling ensures admins cannot access protected routes without authentication and can securely log out.
Forms on support and inquiry pages prevent empty submissions and show feedback messages post submission.
Navigation menus adapt between desktop and mobile views with accessible toggle and close interactions.
validation_criteria: All core navigation elements function correctly with accurate links and states on desktop and mobile.
Homepage hero section loads images and autoplay carousel without errors or broken text.
All public pages display correct content with optimized images and no layout shifts.
Product pages update dynamically based on route parameters with correct data loading and navigation.
Admin login validates credentials properly, redirects, and handles session securely.
CMS actions for content update reflect changes immediately on the public site.
Inquiry and support forms validate input, show success or error feedback, and handle API failures gracefully.
No console errors or warnings during user interactions, especially on server actions or data mutations.
Responsive layouts render properly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screen sizes.
Recent fixes verified including hero carousel import resolution, image saving error fixes, and product material naming consistency.
